title: Wapas Mein Chali Aaee Hoon Wada Hova Pura
body:
Zainab yeh fugaa karti thi utho mere bhaiya
<<MINI>>
Wapas mein chali aaee hoon wada hova pura
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Adaa ne phiraya mujhe be maqna o chader
Mein saath liye aaee hoon ujda huwa kunba
<<MINI>>
Wapas mein chali aaee hoon wada huwa pura
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Rodad e safar kehne ki taaqat nahi bhai
Daoran e safar mera ajab haal huwa tha
<<MINI>>
Wapas mein chali aaee hoon wada huwa pura
<<DIVIDER>>
3 Kya saqt masayeb se guzar aaee hai Zainab
Woh Shaam ka bazaar wo darbar woh Kufa
<<MINI>>
Wapas mein chali aaee hoon wada huwa pura
<<DIVIDER>>
4 Jab hum ko sitamgar se mila huk me rihaee
Him aagaye aur rahgayi zindaan mein Sakina
<<MINI>>
Wapas mein chali aaee hoon wada huwa pura
<<DIVIDER>>
5 Zindaan mein dum tod gayi naazoo ki paali
Tha misle kafan tan pe wahi khoon bhara kurta
<<MINI>>
Wapas mein chali aaee hoon wada huwa pura
<<DIVIDER>>
6 Woh Shaam ka darbar woh na moose payamber
Woh karb ka alam woh do alam ka masiha
<<MINI>>
Wapas mein chali aaee hoon wada huwa pura
<<DIVIDER>>
7 Puchege jo sugra hai kahan Qasim o akber
Bas itna bata dijeye mein usse kaho kya
<<MINI>>
Wapas mein chali aaee hoon wada huwa pura
<<DIVIDER>>
8 Aye jaan o dil e Fatima Allah nigehbaan
Ho aap yahan aur watan jaati hai dukhiya
<<MINI>>
Wapas mein chali aaee hoon wada huwa pura
<<DIVIDER>>
9 Us waqt sohail ek qiyamat ka samaa tha
Yeh kehke bahen qabr pe karti thi jo girya
<<MINI>>
Wapas mein chali aaee hoon wada huwa pura
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz :- Raza Ali sohail.
